verdict.rationale: FireHydrant documents AI summaries that are generated as soon as an incident is declared, surfaced in Slack (with notifications when a new summary is generated), and tailored to stakeholder groups through Audiences. Its Scribe joins Zoom and Google Calendar incident bridges to capture discussions and decisions, and AI captures Zoom chat insights, so the live-summary and scribed-call-notes parts of the story are clearly delivered. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of AI-drafted stakeholder or status updates during the incident (only implied by audience-tailored summaries; AI drafting is documented for post-incident retrospectives), and no independent or hands-on corroboration.
